svg.title: What the alert data cannot say yet
svg.desc: What the alert data cannot say yet. Two things a reader might ask for, and why neither is drawn.
svg.text: What the alert data cannot say yet
Two things a reader might ask for, and why neither is drawn.
Not available: acknowledgement of an alert is not recorded. A notification has a
read flag but no timestamp, and nothing records that someone acted on an alert.
Not available: time from an alert to its deadline item closing is recorded per
item (DeadlineItem.closedAt, linked by AlertLog.itemId) but it is not computed or
Notifications created: 810; marked read: 0; unread: 810. The read flag is not informative in
this demo dataset, so no response-rate figure is drawn.
Provenance: NOT AVAILABLE (stated limits of the data)
